items.question: The property manager must ensure that renters understand ------- rental agreement.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“their”代入题干后为“The property manager must ensure that renters understand their rental agreement.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：A（their）。
